name: @yiyunet/dsh-proxy-egress
description: 本地出口代理（egress）桥：把只接受无凭据 HTTP(S) 代理地址的消费方，接到需要账号密码的上游代理上。失败即断联，绝不改走直连。零构建、零运行时依赖。 Local egress proxy bridge for DSH: hand a credential-free proxy URL to consumers that reject credentials, and inject the upstream auth on the hop that needs it. Fail-closed:
